title: Forever Reign
lyrics_original: You are good – You are good
When there's nothing good in me
You are love – You are love
On display for all to see
You are light – You are light
When the darkness closes in
You are hope – You are hope
You have covered all my sin
You are peace – You are peace
When my fear is crippling
You are true – You are true
Even in my wandering
You are joy – You are joy
You're the reason that I sing
You are life – You are life
In you death has lost it's sting
Oh, I'm running to Your arms
I'm running to Your arms
The riches of Your love
Will always be enough
Nothing compares to Your embrace
Light of the world forever reign
You are more – You are more
Than my words will ever say
You are Lord – You are Lord
All creation will proclaim
You are here – You are here
In your presence I'm made whole
You are God – You are God
Of all else I'm letting go
Hallelujah, forever
All the glory, forever
All the praise to You
My heart will sing
No other name
Jesus, Jesus

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

bible_verses.telugu: మరల యేసు నేను లోకమునకు వెలుగును, నన్ను వెంబడించువాడు చీకటిలో నడువక జీవపు వెలుగుగలిగి యుండునని వారితో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా దయాళుడు ఆయనకు కృతజ్ఞతా స్తుతులు చెల్లించుడి ఆయన కృప నిత్యముండును.
bible_verses.english: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being good even when I feel empty, and for being my light when darkness surrounds me. When fear threatens to overwhelm my heart, help me rest in Your perfect peace. Thank You for covering my sin with Your sacrificial love on display at the cross. I surrender my doubts and worries to You today, trusting that You reign forever over my life. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being good even when I feel empty, and for being my light when darkness surrounds me. When fear threatens to overwhelm my heart, help me rest in Your perfect peace. Thank You for covering my sin with Your sacrificial love on display at the cross. I surrender my doubts and worries to You today, trusting that You reign forever over my life. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming and our own strength runs dry, "Forever Reign" anchors us in the unchanging character of God. He does not love us because of our goodness, but because goodness and love define who He is. In moments of deep fear, darkness, or sin, Christ shines as our light, hope, and peace. Singing these lyrics invites us to surrender our worries and rest fully in the secure, reigning love of Jesus.
